# crates_search MCP tool

> Search the ranked crates.io dataset by words (name, keywords, categories, description); results ordered by relevance then score. Input schema, parameters and…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-search/

Search the ranked crates.io dataset by words (name, keywords, categories, description); results ordered by relevance then score.

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "crates_search",
    "arguments": {
      "query": "<query>"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | `string` | yes |  |
| `category` | `string` | no | crates.io category slug or unique part of it |
| `limit` | `integer` | no |  |

## Input schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "category": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "crates.io category slug or unique part of it"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "query"
  ]
}
```
